title: Beyond Monolingual Assumptions: A Survey on Code-Switched NLP in the Era of Large Language Models across Modalities

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing dataset compositions to reveal English-centric overrepresentation (e.g., focusing heavily on English-Spanish or English-Hindi) and evaluating performance disparities, such as Word Error Rate and semantic accuracy drops, between monolingual, high-resource code-switched, and low-resource code-switched language pairs across NLP tasks.

Reviewing literature and model failures to show how LLMs lack understanding of sociolinguistic pragmatics, regional nuances, and cultural norms in mixed-language discourse, often relying on literal translations or failing to capture the communicative intent behind code-switching.
